input.speaker: input when every turn carries one, else A for every turn

engine.input_hash: memory/extraction/shadow.rs hash_input: sha256 over turn, then per message id, u64 little-endian UTF-8 length of text, text; with a window, NUL 'context', the turn count, then per earlier turn its id, message count and messages; lowercase hex

window.units: the turn's messages joined with a newline into one turn, each context turn likewise, every turn speaker A (the input carries no role); language detected from the window's script (script-v2); VAD reads the current turn alone

offsets: UTF-8 byte offsets into one message's text, end exclusive; surfaces[i] is the text of spans[i]
